result.title: Advancing Cognitive Pairwise Comparisons for Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
result.comment: 33 pages, 19 tables, 8 figures; interactive web demos available at https://kkfyuen.github.io/cpcHCADDemos ; source code and datasets at https://github.com/kkfyuen/cpcHCADDemos ; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23434993 ; earlier preprint version available at SSRN 4048692 (http://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.4048692 or https://ssrn.com/abstract=4048692)
result.summary: Human-centric artificial intelligence and data science (HCAD) systems increasingly involve human-in-the-loop (HITL) interventions to overcome the limitations of fully automated machine learning algorithms, such as automation bias and the inability to incorporate tacit domain knowledge, and continuously improve predictive performance. Data transformations, feature selection, feature weighting, and model selection usually require laborious human involvement across iterations of artificial intelligence and data science (AI&DS) pipelines, making development a challenging and time-consuming process. The Cognitive Pairwise Comparison (CPC) framework is proposed as a human-centric methodology to elicit preferences and priorities in a structured format. To establish essential facets of human-centricity, this research advances the CPC methodology so that user preference elicitation can be systematically quantified in these challenging AI&DS tasks. To demonstrate the usability and validity of these facets, this study presents several applications within movie recommender systems using the MovieLens dataset. It exemplifies how the extended CPC framework can facilitate interactions between human judgments and data across supervised learning, dimensionality reduction, and unsupervised learning algorithms.

AI.brief_summary: 该文扩展 Cognitive Pairwise Comparison 方法，用结构化成对比较量化人的偏好与优先级，并在 MovieLens 推荐任务中演示人在回路中的特征选择、加权和模型选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究聚焦表格型推荐管线中的人类偏好引导与特征加权，不涉及多模态/视觉推理、latent 状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，也未提供可核查的具体方法线索。
